items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1978-04-20
items.q: Well, those were the days of Ernie the Whip.

ctx.x: Do I have or did I? Did you then in those days? Well, ever now and then, now, the record would come by. Not that it was during depression, but I still remember that there were graphing over in the neighborhood. And records weren't really plentiful at all. They were very thick, seven eggs. And a few people in the neighborhood had a new-fangled record player. But most of it was radio, more than record.
Well, those were the days of Ernie the Whip.
Well, I remember even though before, like in my early childhood, five, six, seven, eight.
